ui.agents.proposals.title_create.role: Heading of a proposal that would create a profile that does not exist yet
ui.agents.proposals.title_create.note: {name} is the proposed agent or team name, an identifier, never translated. Distinct from 'title' (a change to an existing profile): nothing exists until Accept succeeds.

ui.agents.proposals.fields.role: Line under a proposal title listing what it changes
ui.agents.proposals.fields.note: {fields} is a comma-separated list of field names supplied by the app (for example 'Instructions, Tools'); keep it as one argument and do not translate or reorder its contents. Example: 'Changes: Instructions, Tools'.

ui.agents.proposals.stale.role: Warning on a proposal whose profile changed after it was proposed
ui.agents.proposals.stale.tone: Plain, factual; not an error tone
ui.agents.proposals.stale.note: {name} is an identifier. This is a refusal, not success: Accept is disabled and nothing was applied; the person should ask the originating conversation for a fresh proposal. Do not suggest the proposal will be updated automatically.

ui.agents.proposals.waiting.role: Tooltip/accessible count of pending proposals for the Agents navigation item or a roster row
ui.agents.proposals.waiting.note: ICU plural on {count} (1 or more). Give every CLDR plural category the language needs, including 'one' with singular agreement. 'Agents' is the navigation section: use the exact term of ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agents in your language.

ui.agents.proposals.review.role: Link from a conversation tool row to the proposal in Agents
ui.agents.proposals.review.note: 'Agents' is the navigation section: use the exact term of ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agents in your language.

ui.agents.proposals.new_group.role: Heading of the Agents list group holding proposed profiles that do not exist yet
ui.agents.proposals.new_group.note: Groups proposals to create a NEW agent or team, shown under the existing roster so a pending creation can be opened and reviewed. Use the same 'Agents' vocabulary as the navigation if a section name appears.

ui.agents.proposals.new_row.role: Secondary line on a proposed-new row in the Agents list
ui.agents.proposals.new_row.note: Status of a proposed profile awaiting the operator's Accept or Reject; nothing has been created yet.
